title: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie
plot: A determined cop investigates the murder of a young, beautiful girl, only to find himself entangled in a web of rumors and deceit.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E01.mkv
episodes.title: S02E01 - Episode 1
episodes.plot: When the foundation-laying ceremony of a highway project unearths a skeleton, all hell breaks loose. SP Rathika appoints SI Moosa Raaza, a straightforward cop who's infamous for his doggedness, as the Lead Investigator. As he digs deeper, he finds a much bigger mystery - one that leads him to Mani.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E02.mkv
episodes.title: S02E02 - Episode 2
episodes.plot: When SI Moosa Raaza seeks DNA testing to identify skeletal remains, the results reveal a match to the very victim Mani is imprisoned for murdering. Raaza faces intense moral turmoil as he realizes his discovery might result in an innocent man's wrongful conviction.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E03.mkv
episodes.title: S02E03 - Episode 3
episodes.plot: Haunted by Mani's suicide attempt in prison, SI Moosa Raaza is consumed by doubts about Mani's guilt in the double murder. As testimonies crack and friends reveal secrets, Mani himself refuses to defend his innocence. Just as Raaza's intiuition sharpens, a new DNA report shatters certainty-revealing a hidden trace that suggests the true killer still walks free.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E04.mkv
episodes.title: S02E04 - Episode 4
episodes.plot: SP Rathika brings in her lawyer-husband Sukumaran to help with Mani's case. Mani opens up to SI Moosa and Sukumaran and recalls what happened with him and Nilavathi. However, Moosa and SP Rathika must find a way to reopen the case against the wishes of their higher-ups, even if it means staking everything. With official channels closing in, Raaza devises a bold strategy to turn the tables.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E05.mkv
episodes.title: S02E05 - Episode 5
episodes.plot: Mani's memories of Nilavathi haunt him as Moosa presses forward despite political pressure. DNA results disappoint. Nilavathi's father confronts Moosa about reopening wounds. A gruesome discovery-a human hand dragged by a stray dog-adds urgency, tying Mani's case to a chilling new crime.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E06.mkv
episodes.title: S02E06 - Episode 6
episodes.plot: SP Rathika and SI Moosa face the IG's hostility over DNA evidence linking six murders. He wants to wrap up the case ASAP. Media frenzy grows, Mani's mother struggles, and Sumaya fears Raaza's obsession. The spectre of a serial killer looms, but politics and human frailty complicate the hunt.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E07.mkv
episodes.title: S02E07 - Episode 7
episodes.plot: Mani reunites briefly with his family. Moosa and Dr. Dhanapal confront baffling DNA contradictions. However, a shocking discovery reveals the source of the "serial killer's DNA". Still, Moosa begins to unravel gaps in Mani's past that lead to deeper questions and shock.

episodes.name: Vadhandhi: The Fable of Velonie - S02E08.mkv
episodes.title: S02E08 - Episode 8
episodes.plot: Moosa's faith shaken by a partly resolved mystery, decides to take a firm hand with Mani and Sundaresan to uncover the hidden facets of Mani's past. As the full story begins to unravel, Moosa pieces together the truth behind the deaths of Nilavathi and Venba. Realizing that truth is indeed stranger than fiction, Moosa is left to wonder if his profession is ultimately a bane rather than a boon

episodes.name: Pritam.and.Pedro.2026.S01E03.1080p.DS4K.SDR.10bit.JHS.WEBRip.HIN-TAM-TEL-KAN-MAL-BHO-BEN-MAR.DDP5.1.Atmos.x265.HEVC-OlaM.mkv - S01E03.mkv

episodes.name: Pritam.and.Pedro.2026.S01E04.1080p.DS4K.SDR.10bit.JHS.WEBRip.HIN-TAM-TEL-KAN-MAL-BHO-BEN-MAR.DDP5.1.Atmos.x265.HEVC-OlaM.mkv - S01E04.mkv
episodes.title: S01E04 - Episode 4
episodes.plot: Digging into Vinny's secret online game, Pedro and Pritam uncover a digital maze. A subtle discovery rattles the family, as Pritam's past creeps closer than he expects.

episodes.name: Pritam.and.Pedro.2026.S01E05.1080p.DS4K.SDR.10bit.JHS.WEBRip.HIN-TAM-TEL-KAN-MAL-BHO-BEN-MAR.DDP5.1.Atmos.x265.HEVC-OlaM.mkv - S01E05.mkv

episodes.plot: Pedro wants to catch a criminal, but Pritam wants to track a mind. The hunt flips, turning the case into a cat-and-mouse game where Pedro isn't sure who is chasing whom.

title: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E12.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv
plot: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E01.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E01.mkv
episodes.title: S01E01 - Episode 1
episodes.plot: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E02.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E02.mkv
episodes.title: S01E02 - Episode 2
episodes.plot: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E03.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E03.mkv
episodes.title: S01E03 - Episode 3
episodes.plot: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E04.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E04.mkv
episodes.title: S01E04 - Episode 4
episodes.plot: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E05.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E05.mkv
episodes.title: S01E05 - Episode 5
episodes.plot: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E06.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E06.mkv
episodes.title: S01E06 - Episode 6
episodes.plot: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E07.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E07.mkv
episodes.title: S01E07 - Episode 7
episodes.plot: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E08.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E08.mkv
episodes.title: S01E08 - Episode 8
episodes.plot: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E09.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E09.mkv
episodes.title: S01E09 - Episode 9
episodes.plot: A disturbance at the camp shifts the military's understanding of the virus. A thunderstorm provides cover as the group agrees to keep on moving.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E10.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E10.mkv
episodes.title: S01E10 - Episode 10
episodes.plot: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

episodes.name: All.of.Us.Are.Dead.S01E11.1080p.NF.WEB-DL.DDP5.1.x264-Telly.mkv - S01E11.mkv
episodes.title: S01E11 - Episode 11
episodes.plot: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.
